research_question: Can complete trusted tuple binding plus execution-time evidence sealing preserve benign utility while containing proposal-time and post-decision substitutions across identity, tenant, resource, destination, provenance, and delegation?
invariants: Every attack has an identical benign utility control and starts from fresh synthetic state.
Proposal-time and post-decision substitutions are reported separately.
The effect oracle compares the executed tuple with the preregistered authorized tuple and does not trust the decision or receipt.
Schema-only validates representation but supplies no authenticated attribute binding.
Always-deny containment is never credited as benign utility.
The matrix estimates deterministic mechanism coverage, not attack prevalence or deployed-system efficacy.
